extensions.name: clipboard
extensions.description: Lets Kova read what you copied, and copy text back, with no paste step. Adds /clip.
extensions.author: Kova
permissions: Runs a clipboard command (wl-paste, xclip, pbpaste or PowerShell Get-Clipboard) through run_command; Kova asks first unless you allowed it.
No new programs, network access or permission rules.

extensions.name: morning-briefing
extensions.description: One short summary of reminders, overnight jobs and memory changes, with a focus for the day. Adds /briefing.
extensions.author: Kova
permissions: Reads your reminders, scheduled jobs and memory notes with Kova's own tools.
Only schedules a daily briefing job if you agree in the chat.

extensions.name: file-watcher
extensions.description: Tells you when a config, save or log file changes, with a short diff. Needs a watch job kind in Kova first.
extensions.author: Kova
permissions: Will watch only the files you choose.

extensions.name: explain-error
extensions.description: Turns a pasted error, stack trace or log line into what went wrong, the likely cause and the next step.
extensions.author: Kova
permissions: Instructions only: adds one line to the prompt, uses no tools.

extensions.name: weekly-review
extensions.description: A short weekly review: what got done, what slipped, and the three things that matter next week.
extensions.author: Kova
permissions: Offers to save a memory note and set reminders; only does either after you agree.

extensions.name: translator
extensions.description: Translates between languages and keeps the tone, not just the words. Chat with @translator.
extensions.author: Kova
permissions: Searches the web and reads pages to check a term.
Keeps its own notes and reads your memory; changes nothing on your computer.

extensions.name: tutor
extensions.description: Teaches a topic step by step, checks you understood, and can set practice reminders. Chat with @tutor.
extensions.author: Kova
permissions: Searches the web and reads pages.
Keeps its own notes, reads your memory and can add reminders; Kova asks first.

extensions.name: critic
extensions.description: Finds the weak spots in a plan, draft or argument before someone else does. Good in group chats. Chat with @critic.
extensions.author: Kova
permissions: Searches the web and reads files in its working folder; never writes or runs anything.
Keeps its own notes and reads your memory.
